<thought>The dominant peak at m/z 193.1103 likely corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~192.103 Da. An isotopic M+1 intensity of ~12 % suggests about 11 carbons. A formula that matches the exact mass within a few ppm is C₁₁H₁₄NO₂ (neutral mass 192.1025 Da). This fits the observed mass and isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2N</final_answer>
